# Set-ZbxToken

## SYNOPSIS

Changes an API token.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxToken [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixToken>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-Description <string>] [-Status <ZabbixAuthToken>] [-ExpiresAt <DateTimeOffset>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

An API token logs a user in to the API without a password; it is created without its secret, which the server generates once (token.generate). The Set-ZbxToken cmdlet changes the API tokens given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with token.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every API token the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed API tokens back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change an API token

```powershell
Set-ZbxToken -InputObject 'Inventory script' -Status Disabled
```

Disables the API token Inventory script, so the API refuses it.

### Example 2: Change an API token and write the result

```powershell
Set-ZbxToken -InputObject 'Inventory script' -Status Disabled -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the API token Inventory script back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixToken>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName), -Description (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixAuthToken`: Bound to -Status (ByPropertyName). The auth token values: ZBX_AUTH_TOKEN_* in defines.inc.php.
- `DateTimeOffset`: Bound to -ExpiresAt (ByPropertyName).
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixToken`: Token class.
